# Omnimo vs TypingMind

Updated November 25, 2026 · prices from the US App Store

TypingMind and Omnimo solve the same problem, many models in one place, in opposite ways. TypingMind is software you buy once and connect to the AI providers with your own API keys. Omnimo includes the models: no keys, one subscription.

## Side by side

|  | Omnimo | TypingMind |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Made by | An independent developer | TypingMind |
| Models | GPT-6, Claude, Gemini, Grok, DeepSeek, Kimi, Qwen, GLM and MiniMax: from several makers, switchable mid-chat, plus Apple Intelligence on the device | whichever providers you bring an API key for |
| Price (US) | Free; Omnimo Pro $6.99 a week (3-day trial), $9.99 a month, $39.99 a year (1-week trial) | a lifetime license, paid once (price on typingmind.com); you also pay the AI providers for what you use, with your own API keys |
| Free to start | Unlimited Apple Intelligence on the device; a few messages a day with GPT-6 Luna, Claude Haiku 5.5, Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite, DeepSeek V4 Flash and Qwen 3.8 Flash; one image a day | No free app; a paid license |
| On-device model | Apple Intelligence, free, unlimited and offline (iOS, iPadOS or macOS 26 on a supported device) | Not in its listing |
| What the listing highlights | photos the model can see, documents read on the device, Ask Web with sources, image and video generation, your own assistants, voice, Siri and Shortcuts, a widget, 46 languages, no account | a chat interface in the browser, your own API keys, data stored locally by default, agents, prompts, plugins and a knowledge base |
| App Store rating | New: one rating on the US App Store when we checked | not on the App Store (a web app) |

Omnimo: the app's App Store listing and its pricing (US). TypingMind: its website, read 25 November 2026. Prices in other countries differ.

## Where TypingMind is better

With TypingMind you pay once for the interface and then only for what you use, at the providers' own prices, with any model your keys reach. It stores data locally by default and has agents, plugins, prompts and a knowledge base. For a heavy or technical user it can be much more flexible.

## Where Omnimo is better

Omnimo needs no API keys, accounts with providers or setup: install it and ask. It is a native iPhone, iPad and Mac app with a camera for photo questions, Siri and Shortcuts, a widget and Apple Intelligence free on the device. The price is fixed, with a free tier to start.

## The honest verdict

**Choose TypingMind** if you already have API keys, use AI heavily, and want to pay providers directly.

**Choose Omnimo** if you want a phone app that works without keys or setup.

Both are free to try: [TypingMind](https://www.typingmind.com) and [Omnimo on the App Store](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6504996891). Omnimo is made by the team that writes this site, so weigh this page accordingly; we have tried to say where TypingMind wins.

## Questions

### Do I need an API key for Omnimo?

No. The models are included. A free plan gives a few cloud messages a day and unlimited Apple Intelligence; Omnimo Pro gives every model.

### Is TypingMind an iPhone app?

TypingMind is a web app that runs in the browser; it is not on the App Store.

### Which is cheaper?

It depends on use. TypingMind is a one-time license plus what the providers charge for your usage. Omnimo Pro is $6.99 a week, $9.99 a month or $39.99 a year in the US, models included.
